سَحْجٌ inf. n. of سَحَجَ. (TA.) ―
-b2- And [hence, Dysentery, or the like; because attended by abrasion, or excoriation, of the colon;] a certain disease of the bowels; (PS;) an abrading disease in the belly. (TA.) You say, بِهِ سَحْجٌ (S) i. e. In him is the disease above mentioned. (PS.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
